def solution():
    # Define variables
    principal = 300_000
    annual_interest_rate = 0.04
    loan_term_years = 30
    monthly_rate = annual_interest_rate / 12
    number_of_payments = loan_term_years * 12

    # Calculate the monthly payment and total interest
    monthly_payment = principal * monthly_rate / (
        1 - (1 + monthly_rate) ** -number_of_payments
    )
    total_interest = monthly_payment * number_of_payments - principal

    # Return interest rounded to the nearest dollar
    return round(total_interest)
